description.en: Original simplified Kimberella quadrata fossil-specimen study informed by South Australian Museum P49391 photograph published by scientist-curated Ediacaran.org, not a replica, scan or whole living animal reconstruction. Primary Evans,Droser,Erwin2021 text and caption describe negative-hyporelief external moulds and interpretation uncertainty; their Fig2 specimens LV-FUN001/P35660 are contextual text only, not the selected viewed specimen. Nominal fossil length70mm in65x100x7mm sandstone slab illustrative, not measurement from source scale bar. Central impression preserved morphology, ruffled margin interpretation not settled muscular-foot identity. Hidden slab thickness and neutral sandstone palette artistic.
